title: Ternary Quantum Eraser Cryptography
summary: Quantum key distribution protocols based on the quantum eraser phenomenon offer an operational advantage: automatic identification of matching and mismatching encoding choices through interference, eliminating basis reconciliation. However, binary quantum eraser implementations permit an eavesdropper to recover Alice's encoded bit with $85\%$ probability. To overcome this constraint, we introduce a ternary quantum eraser protocol employing three polarization states with $120^\circ$ angular separation, transmitted in three-photon groups with randomized temporal ordering.
